newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 28.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:

-- Transport Ministry plans to begin allocating about 30 of the 40 extra landing slots at Haneda airport. The new landing rights, effective from July, will allow airlines to freely set flight schedules for the first time.
-- Leading steelmakers, including Kawasaki Steel Corp and Kobe Steel Ltd, plan to increase recruitment of high school graduates from April 1998.
-- Government plans to cut defence spending under the current five-year defence build-up plan, which totals about 25 trillion yen, as part of efforts to restore deficit-ridden national finances.
